title: Failed Job Has No CSV
description: When report generation blows up partway through, the job should end up honestly marked failed with an explanation — not silently sitting at a status that implies a CSV exists when it doesn't.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs with an invalid IANA timeZone value that isn't a real timezone (e.g. "Nowhere/Fake") — this causes the async bucketing step to throw. Poll GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id until status becomes "failed" (not "ready"). Querying report_jobs via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms status = 'failed', failure_reason IS NOT NULL (a non-empty string), and result_csv IS STILL NULL — the failure path never left a partial or garbage CSV behind.
hints: The queued job's catch block (apps/api/src/modules/reporting/service.ts's createReportJob) sets status: "failed" and failureReason from the caught error's message, and never touches resultCsv at all in that branch.
GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id/download against this failed job should return 409, the same as it would for a still-pending job — failed and pending both mean "nothing downloadable exists."
